snippet.description:
Sexual assault on college campuses isn’t new, but a recent incident at Cornell University has sparked outrage and conversation among women across generations. Vox’s Jonquilyn Hill speaks with Rebecca Zipkin, vice president of policy and programs at World Without Exploitation, about the factors driving sexual assault at colleges and universities.
